'''Hanos Darr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]], and a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was part of the group which traveled to the [[The Graveyard|rubble]] left behind after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in an effort to locate [[Ore/Legends|ores]], stationed at [[Mining Outpost 11]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Operation Yavin Kill Two|leaked rumors]] to the miners that a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] unit had discovered the location of the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Royal Palace]] of Alderaan in the debris field, then ordered all miners to leave the outpost. It was hoped that the information would be passed on to the Alliance, and lure [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] into a trap. While the majority of the miners spread the rumors far and wide, Darr and another Alliance agent, [[Zaz Kamiroz]], headed for the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']] and made contact with a local agent, the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]], [[Poliss]]. Using the code phrase that they were looking for their "cousins from Yavin," they waited for an audience with the Princess. Two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after arriving on the ''Bazaar'', Darr was tracked down by the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[XS3]], who had been dispatched by the Empire to lend credence to their ruse. The droid chased Darr into the jungle outside [[Isttu Village]] and mortally wounded him, despite the intervention of a group of Alliance agents on unrelated business. Before dying, he passed on Kamiroz's name to the team of Alliance agents.
